2607.13837.title: NodeImport: Imbalanced Node Classification with Node Importance Assessment
2607.13837.paper_summary: In real-world applications, node classification on graphs often faces the challenge of class imbalance, where majority classes dominate training, resulting in biased model performance. Traditional GNNs often struggle in such scenarios, as they tend to overfit to majority classes while underrepresenting minority classes. Existing solutions, which either prioritize nodes based on class size or synthesize new nodes for minority classes, often fall short of effectively addressing this imbalance issue. This paper introduces an approach to class-imbalanced node classification by utilizing a balanced meta-set for importance measurement, where a training node is considered significant if it enhances model performance under an unbiased setting. Our method identifies important nodes that can counteract class imbalance and utilizes them for model training, allowing for fine-grained and dynamic node selection throughout the training process. We theoretically derive a formula to directly assess node importance, reducing computational overhead and providing an intuitive threshold for node selection. Guided by this metric, we develop a novel framework that filters valuable labeled, unlabeled, and synthetic nodes that enhance model performance in an unbiased context. A key advantage of this framework is its separation of the synthetic node generation process from the filtering process, ensuring compatibility with various node generation methods. Furthermore, we introduce a strategy to construct a high-quality meta-set that closely approximates the overall feature distribution, ensuring robust representation of each class. We evaluate our framework, NodeImport, across multiple datasets using popular GNN architectures, demonstrating its superiority over existing baselines. Our results highlight the flexibility and effectiveness of the framework in mitigating class imbalance, leading to improved outcomes.
2607.13837.paper_summary_zh: 在現實世界的應用中，圖上的節點分類常常面臨類別不平衡的挑戰，其中多數類別主導訓練，導致模型性能偏頗。傳統的GNN在這種情況下往往表現不佳，因為它們傾向於過度擬合多數類別，而對少數類別的表示不足。現有的解決方案，無論是根據類別大小優先考慮節點，還是為少數類別合成新節點，通常都無法有效解決這一不平衡問題。本文提出了一種通過利用平衡的元集合來進行類別不平衡的節點分類的方法，在這裡，當訓練節點在無偏見的設置下能提高模型性能時，該節點被認為是重要的。我們的方法識別出能夠抵消類別不平衡的重要節點，並利用它們進行模型訓練，允許在整個訓練過程中進行細緻和動態的節點選擇。我們理論上推導出一個公式來直接評估節點的重要性，減少計算開銷，並為節點選擇提供直觀的閾值。在這一指標的指導下，我們開發了一個新穎的框架，過濾有價值的標記、未標記和合成節點，以提升模型在無偏見背景下的性能。這一框架的一個主要優勢是將合成節點生成過程與過濾過程分開，確保與各種節點生成方法的兼容性。此外，我們還提出了一種構建高質量元集合的策略，該元集合能夠密切近似整體特徵分佈，確保每個類別的穩健表示。我們在多個數據集上使用流行的GNN架構評估我們的框架NodeImport，證明其優於現有基準。我們的結果突顯了該框架在減輕類別不平衡方面的靈活性和有效性，從而導致更好的結果。
